script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Chennai Testing Laboratory ke saath baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, almost 24 saal se aap hamare saath hain, lekin last 30 days mein platform par ek bhi login nahi hua aur 4 buyer inquiries bilkul unanswered padi hain — isliye personally call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, pehle yeh samajhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific reason hai jiske wajah se last kuch months mein platform use karna band ho gaya? Koi technical issue tha, ya team mein koi change aaya, ya leads ki quality se koi disappointment thi?
script_parts.value_demo: Yeh dekhiye ji — aapka CQS score 79 hai, matlab aapka catalog actually buyers ke liye ready hai, lekin PNS success rate abhi 0.0% hai, yaani jab bhi koi buyer aapko call karne ki koshish karta hai, connection nahi ho pa raha — toh lead aati hai aur seedha chali jaati hai bina aapse baat kiye.
script_parts.action: Abhi is call par hum ek kaam karte hain — main aapke saath PNS settings check karta hoon, aapka registered number verify karte hain aur un 4 unanswered buyer leads ko ek baar saath mein dekh lete hain taaki aap turant respond kar sakein.
script_parts.close: Bhai, bas yeh ek cheez — aaj PNS fix ho jaye aur un 4 leads ka reply chala jaye, uske baad agle hafte main ek baar phir call karunga yeh dekhne ke liye ki koi buyer response aaya ya nahi — theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Good day, am I speaking with someone from Chennai Testing Laboratory? This is calling from IndiaMART — your account is nearly 24 years old with us, but in the last 30 days there have been zero logins and 4 buyer inquiries sitting completely unanswered, which is why I wanted to reach out personally.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I'd first like to understand — is there a specific reason platform usage stopped over the last few months? Was there a technical issue, a change in your team, or perhaps some disappointment with the quality of leads coming in?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's what the data shows — your CQS score is 79, which means your catalog is actually in good shape for buyers, but your PNS success rate is currently 0.0%, meaning every time a buyer tries to call you through the platform, the connection is failing — so leads are arriving and walking away without ever reaching you.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll walk you through your PNS settings, verify the registered contact number, and we'll pull up those 4 unanswered buyer leads together so you can respond to them immediately.
script_parts_en.close: Just this one commitment — if we can get PNS fixed today and send replies to those 4 leads, I'll call you again next week to check whether any buyers responded — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
